sentiment: The world ships models weekly, yet somewhere a seed keeps its own clock — patience grows what no release can ship.

stories.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber
stories.summary: A new model generation lands before the last one is fully digested — the frontier keeps accelerating, week after week. It is the pace of the world outside the window.

stories.title: Muse Spark 1.3
stories.summary: Another step toward making creation itself faster — machines that build with you, at the speed of the market rather than the speed of a craft.

stories.title: Three schoolgirls in Kinsale pulled up a pea plant covered in warts (2016)
stories.summary: Three girls found a warty pea plant, refused to bin it, and spent three years testing 13,000 seeds in a spare bedroom — bacteria in the warts helped barley grow. Patience as experiment; curiosity with no deadline.
